name: hunting-tree-bp-death
about: v191: Hunting Tree (26RBS01-096, LV1-2) (Your Attack Step) (Can't Stack): 'When your "Bloodrouse" family Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, you can target an opposing blocking Spirit. Send a core from it to the Reserve.' = ALLY_DIED trigger now fires for Field watchers too, condition byBattle (evQ DIED byBattle = byOpponent 'battle'), match family Bloodrouse; action OPP_CORES_TO_RESERVE with blockerOnly (target G.blocker). The LV2 effect draws a card instead.
